author: potuz
content: I think you guys are crazy to add consensus breaking changes at this stage. Anyway, if we are going to go with this I'd like to take a look at some edge cases that I do not see discussed. Something that I consider great about this design is that the signature is no longer needed as we now commit to the full payload in the bid. However, not having the signature is not a simple change in clients. At least Prysm has a bunch of caches to deal with the situation in which the payload arrives before the CL block. When the payload is self-built we can early verify the signature and be safe. When the payload is not self-built we can verify the signature and have a size for that cache avoiding DOS. At any rate, the only possible DOS is from registered entities. If we remove the signature, then anyone can send payloads and we won't be able to early cache them because we haven't seen the block root.
